concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payouts-payout-service-payout-lifecycle]] — 2026-09-15 Payout Service Transfers API lifecycle separating received/authorised/booked accounting events from optional review, post-booking screening, bank/card tracking and bank returns; distinct from the legacy Payout API.
warnings: The return section says non-instant payouts cannot fail but can be returned; read this within its post-dispatch bank-screening context, since earlier API rejection, insufficient-funds refusal and internal-review failure are explicitly documented.
